modules.recommendation: Keep immutable. It correctly preserves package-master first precedence, food-use translation, glass physics, direct print, numeric capture lock and source-brand distance boundaries.

issues.exact_issue: Ingredient-cue size tolerance was ±4%, but direction-lock.series_lock defines a shared product-series scale tolerance of ±3%. The ±4% value belongs only to ingredient_reference_lock.
issues.correction: Changed the product ingredient-cue size tolerance from ±4% to ±3%.
issues.recommendation: Use ±3% for every object inside the product-composition series; reserve ±4% only for the complete subject/dish grouping in individual ingredient-reference frames.

issues.exact_issue: The phrase 'remains inside x 28–72%, y 28–72%' allowed undersized subjects and did not state the direction-lock center ±2-point or scale ±4% tolerances.
issues.correction: Changed the requirement to match the 28–72% outer bounding box within ±4% scale, center x/y 50% within ±2 points, and added the locked down-right contact-shadow direction.
issues.recommendation: Judge the outer glass rim and ingredient together against the numeric box; do not accept a smaller centered dish merely because it is inside the box.

issues.exact_issue: The universal semantic-order row omitted the atmosphere layer even though PRODUCT-COMPOSITION-TEMPLATE and prompt-contract.json both include it.
issues.correction: Aligned the row to subject → role → camera → composition → lighting → surface/background → atmosphere → color grade → texture → output → continuity → negatives.
issues.recommendation: Adapters may translate syntax only; preserve this full ordered meaning layer.

issues.exact_issue: The loop reused ±4% for product ingredient-cue scale, mixing the individual-reference tolerance with the product-series tolerance.
issues.correction: Separated product ingredient cue at ±3% from individual ingredient-reference subject/dish grouping at ±4%.
issues.recommendation: Report these as two different measurements in QA logs.

issues.exact_issue: Migration allowed plain backgrounds only 'where the communication job permits isolation', creating an unauthorized non-mood environmental exception.
issues.correction: Made every non-mood role use the plain Cultured Cream background and prohibited additional environmental exceptions.
issues.recommendation: Brand mood is the only exception. If a non-mood communication job needs context, redesign it as a plain-background object/action study rather than opening a new exception.

issues.exact_issue: The stop-condition wording did not make clear whether the fresh master regeneration was the third counted model-level failure.
issues.correction: Specified two same-axis delta failures, one fresh master-based regeneration, then adapter incompatibility if that same axis fails again.
issues.recommendation: Do not make a fourth model edit on the incompatible adapter; route to a compatible model or deterministic post-production method.

issues.exact_issue: Gate D referred to a copy-safe field even though these centered PDP/collection images do not reserve a copy-safe region.
issues.correction: Replaced it with the unobstructed background field.
issues.recommendation: Measure only empty background pixels outside contact shadows and glass reflections.

issues.exact_issue: The single ingredient_scale_percent value of 4 was ambiguous and contradicted the product-series ±3% scale lock.
issues.recommendation: Consumers must read the tolerance for the active asset role, not one shared ingredient value.

issues.exact_issue: plain_background_scope named only three existing mood angles and could be read as excluding future explicitly approved brand-mood variants while leaving other environmental ambiguity.
issues.correction: Reworded the scope: explicitly designated brand-mood images are the sole exception; every other role uses plain #F5F1E8.
issues.recommendation: Require an explicit brand-mood designation before allowing any environmental background.

issues.exact_issue: The machine-readable contract had no stop conditions even though the Markdown loop did.
issues.correction: Added the exact two-delta-failure reset and third-failure adapter-incompatibility conditions.
issues.recommendation: Automation should terminate the adapter branch when third_same_axis_model_failure is reached.

issues.exact_issue: Coordinate arrays had no declared ordering and could be interpreted differently by adapters.
issues.correction: Replaced arrays with labeled left/top/right/bottom and x/y objects matching direction-lock.json.
issues.recommendation: Keep all future coordinates labeled rather than positional.

cross_module_checks.evidence: Product template, QA loop and JSON contract now share the same twelve-layer prompt order including atmosphere.
Package master controls geometry/material, composition master controls camera/layout, and exactly one matching ingredient reference controls recipe identity; generated SKUs never become masters.
Product center/bbox/object coordinates match direction lock; product scale is ±3%; individual ingredient reference center is ±2 points and its 28–72% grouping scale is ±4%.
Explicit brand-mood designation is the only exception; all other roles require plain seamless matte Cultured Cream #F5F1E8.
Each repair names one causal axis, preserves every passing axis and prohibits moving compensating objects or full-scene restyling.
Two failed same-axis deltas force a clean master reset; failure of the fresh regeneration on that axis is the third failure and terminates the adapter branch.

final_recommendation: Freeze these corrected module checksums with the eight approved reference-image checksums before generating the first SKU.
